notes.title: Game Update - Version 2.0.0
notes.content:
The latest build - ver. 2.0.0 - is now live! Here's a list of the changes:

- Achievements added.
- 19 Sweets themed character skins added to the base game store and the Monstrum + US Creators DLCs.
- 6 New stat seal tiers added. 
- Level cap raised to 666.
- General bug fixes & improvements

notes.title: Patch Update - Ver 1.9.8
notes.content:
We've patched the game to ver. 1.9.8. Here are the latest additions and fixes:

- Added an updated pause menu back into the game. Quitting is allowed during gameplay in Friend Play, but not World Play. This is to reduce player rage quitting during public matches. 

- Stale session fix for World Play. The fix gives a better chance to join matches, because it joins best ping sessions first. This greatly reduces getting kicked back to the main menu for "network errors" or "unknown reason".

- Fixed broken boss pathing in all base game & DLC maps. This includes characters with an ultimate ability that uses pathing (example - Silent Hill's Robbie the Rabbit). 

- Blood moon sky has been added to the Coma 2: Vicious Sisters DLC. Whenever Boss Time triggers, the sky will change to a blood moon as the Butcher begins his hunt. 

- Buffed the Butcher in The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters DLC. He is now more aggressive and does more damage.

notes.title: Poppy Playtime Panic - Patch Update 1
notes.content:
Minor adjustments to the Poppy Playtime DLC were made:

- Cat Bee units nerfed in Trap Time. Reduced to 3 hits required to destroy them (heavy attack = 2 hits, light attack = 1 hit). 

- Cat Bee poison status effect duration reduced to 3 seconds. Poison timer does not reset if the player continues standing in the poison gas.

- Huggy Wuggy's speed buffed in Boss Time. Movement speed increased by 30%.

notes.title: Crazy Carnevil Map is Live!
notes.content:
The Crazy Carnevil map is now playable in Monsters & Mortals! Enjoy! Some of the previous issues fixed:

- collision bugs (falling off walkways)
- portals not working
- boss time (clown goliaths added)

notes.title: Dedicated Server Private Beta
notes.content:
For those who were sent the password to the dedicated server beta, it is now up. It requires there be 6 players to a server, so if there aren't enough people on at a time, uhhh, I won't snitch if you share the password lol.

As of now, there are only 10 servers available (all of which on the World Play, private matches aren't on the dedicated servers yet), but 10 * 6 = 60 so that shouldn't be a problem I'd imagine. However, whenever you first start matchmaking, you may get an error that says something like "FleetExceededCapacity in CreateGameSession," if you get that error message, feel free to ignore it. If you get some other kind of error message, lmk on https://twitter.com/cromwellslimon, but that should be the only error message. The reason why that pops up is just because it's trying to start up a new instance of the dedicated server but it can take like 20 seconds, I have the matchmaking button set to retry on a loop every 10 seconds so if you click "World Play" and then just wait a bit, you'll join a match eventually, if not basically immediately.

Also, we haven't sorted out balancing yet so feel free to leave feedback to me  and I'll relay that to Vince or something, I don't mess with balancing, I'm just the software engineer (ooo, fancy title)

Have fun gaming, gamers
- Simon Cromwell

notes.title: 1.4.2 Update
notes.content:
Here's a list of changes we've made for this patch.

General

 Added a new UI element that shows the currently applied buffs/debuffs (this is shown for the owning player as well as on top of the health bar of other players)
 Brought back the ability for Support Mortals to heal other mortals with their Heavy Attack


Silent Hill DLC

 Reduced Shard Target 1000 > 850
 Removed two Air Screamers
 Fixed Heather's Ultimate affecting healing items and abilities


Monstrum DLC

 Fixed Prisoner's Ultimate not slowing down affected characters
 Fixed Alarm Sound sometimes persisting after Trap Time ended
 AI characters can now enter the Control Room 



Stranger Sewers

 Increased Doom Ducky's damage and collision hitbox

notes.title: 1.3.3 Update
notes.content:
Here's a list of changes we've made for this small patch (also includes changes made in 1.3.2)

Balancing

Clown Gremlin

 Reduced amount of hits necessary to kill a Clown Clone 5 -> 4
 Reduced the total lifetime of Clown Clones 45secs -> 30secs
 Hitting Clown Clones with a heavy attack is now worth 2 hitpoints


Fiend (Monstrum DLC)

 Removed stun from Fiend's ultimate 


Nikson

 Reduced amount of shards collected 30% -> 20%


General Fixes

Character Select

 Attempted to fix an issue where teams weren't given correctly for certain game-modes. (multiple monsters in Maze Escape)

notes.title: Elementary Evil Update (And More)!
notes.content:
Great news - it's update time! There's a ton of new content in this update to share with you all! Here's a quick breakdown of what's new in the Elementary Evil Update:

- The store is now active. Spend your shards & red shards in the store to unlock Extras items and new skins. 

- Elementary Evil map is now playable, featuring a new type of trap, a new boss, and new music!
- 21 new skins (total) for existing mortal & monster characters! Unlock them in the store!
- Soul Collection mode has been added! Compete against 4 mortals and collect shards to save your soul from Malak. Each shard wave, Malak will come for the mortal with the fewest shards. In the end, only one mortal gets to keep their soul. Will it be you? The others will be turned into mindless monsters!

- New additions to the Extras menu! Now you can see & track your stats as you play matches. Build your stats up to unlock higher stat tiers! There is also an art gallery where you can check out art purchased from the store!

- New leveling system! Those wins count for more than just red shards now. Accumulate wins in order to level up and gain new rewards!
- UI/UX improvements! A bit more uniformity in the menu system. 
- Major & minor bug fixes.

Enjoy the new update and get ready for the Monstrum DLC (which is coming up next) :)!

notes.title: Elementary Evil Update is coming in November!
notes.content: It's time to head back to school in Monsters & Mortals! A new form of evil is now lurking in the school hallways and Agatha is up to her usual tricks as well. Watch out for traps! The Elementary Evil map update will arrive before the end of November, so look for the update soon! :)

notes.title: 1.1.5 Update
notes.content:
We have updated the game with some nice quality of life features and bug fixes.

Make sure to restart Steam if you do not receive the update. 


Changelog:


 We have added an information feed widget that should keep all players up to date with important information throughout the match. (kills, respawns, ragequitters etc.) 

 Monsters in Maze Escape will now always see mortals through walls. 

 Mortals in Maze Escape will now always see other mortals through walls.

 Ghosts will now see everyone through walls.

 Shortly after spawning, the player will be invulnerable to all damage for a few seconds.

 Kills made by the Clown Gremlin Clones will now count towards the player who spawned them. 

 The Clown Gremlin Clones are now able to be killed in 5 hits. 

 Chef Monkeys will not block the player anymore.

 Total length of Maze Escape has been shortened 8 > 7 minutes.

 The Mortal Team in Maze Escape will lose up to 25 shards every time they die (from 15)

 And other small bug fixes. 



Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.content: Good news everyone! After much consideration, we've decided to make the Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals Beta Test an open beta instead of a private one! That means that everyone can play and all you have to do is download the demo that we put up on the Steam page on the 16th (at 1:00PM PST). Anyone that submitted their email & Steam ID info to our landing page does not need to worry - the information will be deleted. You will not be signed up for any mailing list or anything like that. We'd definitely appreciate if you all wishlist and follow the game on Steam instead :)!
